import_crunch_2021_24.ruling: NOT RATIFIED as an import-supply haircut — RETIRED PENDING SLICE
import_crunch_2021_24.evidence: HS 8504.23 US general imports rose every year 2021-24 except a -9.7% dip in 2021, reaching 3.6x 2019 units by 2024 (eb_d022_history_check_results.json); the 2021-24 story at class level is demand outrunning inelastic total capacity, not import decline
import_crunch_2021_24.replacement_mechanism: ratified history demand (above) against the import path held at its baseline-inelastic growth band [0.00, 0.02]/yr (base file) — no haircut multiplier in the default history
import_crunch_2021_24.re_entry_rule: IF the >=100,000 kVA HS10 line (8504.23 statistical suffix slice — Author's one-call pull) shows units >=10% below its 2019-20 level during 2021-23, a haircut member U(0.75, 0.95) re-enters the SENSITIVITY set for those years; if flat-or-rising, the haircut retires permanently
import_crunch_2021_24.render_gate: no floor result renders with the haircut active until the slice rules
import_crunch_2021_24.caveat_held_open: the LPT-only signal is genuinely masked by mix shift (nominal value/unit fell 869k->649-676k while prices rose steeply) — the slice, not this class-wide series, adjudicates the >=100 MVA end
